001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import java.util.Arrays;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
008import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
009
010/**
011 * {@code (value = array[index + offset]) || (value = support)}
012 *
013 * @author jimmy
014 */
015public class PropElementValueSupport extends Propagator<IntVar> {
016
017    private final IntVar value;
018    private final IntVar[] array;
019    private final IntVar index;
020    private final int offset;
021    private final int support;
022
023    public PropElementValueSupport(IntVar value, IntVar[] array, IntVar index, int offset, int support) {
024        super(buildArray(value, array, index), PropagatorPriority.LINEAR, false);
025        this.value = value;
026        this.array = array;
027        this.index = index;
028        this.offset = offset;
029        this.support = support;
030    }
031
032    private static IntVar[] buildArray(IntVar value, IntVar[] array, IntVar index) {
033        IntVar[] variables = new IntVar[array.length + 2];
034        variables[0] = value;
035        variables[1] = index;
036        System.arraycopy(array, 0, variables, 2, array.length);
037        return variables;
038    }
039
040    private boolean supportForValue(int value) {
041        if (value == support) {
042            return true;
043        }
044        int ub = index.getUB();
045        for (int i = index.getLB(); i <= ub; i = index.nextValue(i)) {
046            int j = i + offset;
047            if (j >= 0 && j < array.length && array[j].contains(value)) {
048                return true;
049            }
050        }
051        return false;
052    }
053
054    @Override
055    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
056        index.updateLowerBound(-offset, this);
057        index.updateUpperBound(array.length - offset - 1, this);
058
059        if (!value.contains(support)) {
060            int ub = index.getUB();
061            for (int i = index.getLB(); i <= ub; i = index.nextValue(i)) {
062                if (!PropUtil.isDomIntersectDom(value, array[i + offset])) {
063                    index.removeValue(i, this);
064                }
065            }
066        }
067
068        if (index.isInstantiated() && !value.contains(support)) {
069            PropUtil.domSubsetDom(value, array[index.getValue() + offset], this);
070            PropUtil.domSubsetDom(array[index.getValue() + offset], value, this);
071            if (value.isInstantiated()) {
072                setPassive();
073            }
074        } else {
075            int ub = value.getUB();
076            for (int i = value.getLB(); i <= ub; i = value.nextValue(i)) {
077                if (!supportForValue(i)) {
078                    value.removeValue(i, this);
079                }
080            }
081        }
082    }
083
084    @Override
085    public ESat isEntailed() {
086        if (value.contains(support)) {
087            if (index.nextValue(-offset - 1) + offset >= array.length
088                    || index.previousValue(array.length - offset) + offset < 0) {
089                return ESat.FALSE;
090            }
091            if (value.isInstantiated()) {
092                return value.isInstantiatedTo(support) ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.FALSE;
093            }
094            return ESat.UNDEFINED;
095        } else {
096            int ub = index.getUB();
097            for (int i = index.getLB(); i <= ub; i = index.nextValue(i)) {
098                int j = i + offset;
099                if (j >= 0 && j < array.length && PropUtil.isDomIntersectDom(value, array[j])) {
100                    return index.isInstantiated() && value.isInstantiated() && array[j].isInstantiated() ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
101                }
102            }
103            return ESat.FALSE;
104        }
105    }
106
107    @Override
108    public String toString() {
109        return "elementValueSupport " + value + " = " + Arrays.toString(array) + "[" + index + " + " + offset + "] || " + support;
110    }
111}
